TaskDescription: Interictal recording; 1-s epochs centred on the peak of the initial component of an interictal intracerebral spike (IIS) of one mesial temporal network, marked manually (t0)

BandPass.Description: 1.5-30 Hz band-pass (release description); the 30 Hz low-pass is present in the scalp EEG channels only: the SEEG spectrum has no 30 Hz edge (about -40 dB at 200 Hz relative to 3-20 Hz) and 50/150 Hz line-noise peaks in 5 of 9 networks

iEEGReference: Recorded against scalp FPz; SEEG channels released as bipolar derivations of adjacent contacts
iEEGPlacementScheme: Stereotactic depth electrodes, mesial and lateral temporal lobe (see README)
